name: Dog Island and Cool Dog
summary: A jet-ski-riding lifeguard dog that rescues stranded swimmers and can carry you to a small island of dogs in southern Grassrivers.
body: TheGamer says that after swimming away from a boat in open water for about 20 to 30 seconds you hear barking, and Focus Mode points to a dog in a life vest driving a jet ski, called Cool Dog.
According to TheGamer, Cool Dog serves as a way back to shore when you are stranded or your boat is destroyed; choosing Praise while focused on him lets you climb aboard.
TheGamer says staying aboard eventually brings you to Dog Island in the southern part of the Grassrivers region, where Cool Dog joins other dogs under an overturned boat.
TheGamer reports that Cool Dog digs up a wallet holding $1,200 there, and that the Sports Wrap Shade sunglasses lie in a small hole left of the boat and are added to Jason's wardrobe when picked up.
TheGamer says throwing the Frisbee or mini-football for the dogs adds a little Focus progress, that you can ride off on Cool Dog's jet ski, and that your own boat respawns at home for free.
TheGamer says it can be reached as soon as Jason's first day is done, suggesting a trip west from Key Lento into Leonida Bay, and that Lucia can do it later in the story.

GameSpot suggests the jet-skiing dog may be a nod to Loosy, a goggle-wearing golden retriever filmed riding jet skis in Fort Lauderdale, noting the in-game dog is a different breed but also wears goggles.
GameSpot points out that Loosy is not named in the credits and that the link is its own reading, after a fan account made the comparison; Rockstar has not commented.

name: Giant crab at the abandoned research site
summary: An abandoned research site north of Key Lento hides a crab the size of a loveseat, a nod to the 'giant enemy crab' E3 2006 meme.
body: Polygon says an apparently abandoned research site lies north of the Key Lento starting area, with a broken fish tank, small dead crabs and industrial water tanks.
Polygon describes a computer there with a crab logo above its password field, holding field notes for an experiment.
According to Polygon, Jason hears scuttling and a crab the size of a loveseat drops from the rafters and pins him down.
Polygon calls it a random discovery rather than a full side quest, and ties it to the 'giant enemy crab' line from Sony's E3 2006 presentation of Genji 2.

name: Sam Houser cameo
summary: Rockstar president Sam Houser appears as a silent floor-sweeper at a club during a later mission with Boobie.
body: GameSpot reports that in one of the later missions, when Boobie meets Big Mike at a new club, the worker sweeping the floor whom Boobie teases is Rockstar Games president Sam Houser.
GameSpot says the digital Houser does not say a word and wears a white T-shirt with the Rockstar Games logo.
GameSpot notes earlier Houser cameos: an Ammu-Nation clerk voice in GTA 3, a statue of that clerk in GTA: San Andreas, and minor background voice roles in San Andreas and GTA 4.
